description: THE URBAN TRAVELLER RETURNS, POWERED BY SELLITA. The Urban Traveller’s stainless steel case has been refined and trimmed down by nearly 1mm in thickness for a sleeker, more comfortable profile. name: The Banyan Wood Watch
description: Finding a watch that looks considered without costing the earth — literally — is harder than it should be. Most fashion watches rely on mass-produced components, synthetic materials, and packaging that ends up in landfill. The Sustainable Watch Company was built to offer a different kind of timepiece: one where the materials have a previous life and the making process is deliberate by design. Every watch and strap starts life as recycled natural wood furniture, diverting material from waste streams before it ever reaches a wrist. Because each piece is handmade rather than factory-assembled, the energy and resource demands are significantly lower than those of conventional mass-production lines. The brand is entirely vegan — no leather, no animal-derived components — and both product and postal packaging are eco-friendly and recyclable, so nothing about the purchase undermines the ethos behind it. What sets The Sustainable Watch Company apart in practice is the specificity of their environmental commitment: for every watch sold, they plant 10 trees and offset 250 kg of carbon. That is not a rounding gesture — it is a measurable, per-unit action tied directly to each transaction. Choosing recycled wood as the primary material also means that no two watches are identical; the grain, tone, and character of each piece reflect the original furniture it came from, giving every watch a genuinely individual quality that no production line can replicate. • Recycled Chacate Preto wood, upcycled from furniture by hand • Intricate exposed mechanics • High-quality mechanical movement This is a watch that tells more than just the time; it tells a story of thoughtful design and responsible sourcing.

name: The Banyan Wood Watch
description: Finding a watch that looks considered without costing the earth — literally — is harder than it should be. Most fashion watches rely on mass-produced components, synthetic materials, and packaging that ends up in landfill. The Sustainable Watch Company was built to offer a different kind of timepiece: one where the materials have a previous life and the making process is deliberate by design. Every watch and strap starts life as recycled natural wood furniture, diverting material from waste streams before it ever reaches a wrist. Because each piece is handmade rather than factory-assembled, the energy and resource demands are significantly lower than those of conventional mass-production lines. The brand is entirely vegan — no leather, no animal-derived components — and both product and postal packaging are eco-friendly and recyclable, so nothing about the purchase undermines the ethos behind it. What sets The Sustainable Watch Company apart in practice is the specificity of their environmental commitment: for every watch sold, they plant 10 trees and offset 250 kg of carbon. That is not a rounding gesture — it is a measurable, per-unit action tied directly to each transaction. Choosing recycled wood as the primary material also means that no two watches are identical; the grain, tone, and character of each piece reflect the original furniture it came from, giving every watch a genuinely individual quality that no production line can replicate. • Recycled Chacate Preto wood, upcycled from furniture by hand • Intricate exposed mechanics • High-quality mechanical movement This is a watch that tells more than just the time; it tells a story of thoughtful design and responsible sourcing.

name: Fizzics DraftPour Beer Dispenser
description: Ever wished you could have a freshly pulled pint in the comfort of your own home? Now you can! Far more convenient (and cheaper) than installing a full bar, Fizzics’ nifty DraftPour Beer Dispenser will transform any can or bottle of beer into a creamy nitro-style draft with the perfect head on top, enhancing the taste and aroma of your favourite beer. It even has a drip tray to keep your sides clean. Cheers to that!Easy to useSimply place your opened can or bottle of beer inside the machine, and you’re ready to go. Pull the lever towards you while tilting the glass and the machine will pour your beer at a controlled rate and under pressure to maintain the carbonation within the body of the beer.Micro-foam technologyNow for the clever science bit… the DraftPour Beer Dispenser uses sound waves and fluid dynamics to achieve the perfect pint. Once you’ve poured most of your beer, push the handle backward (away from you) to begin the ‘sonication process’, applying sound waves to convert the beer’s natural carbonation into a deliciously creamy micro-foam, giving your beer an aesthetically pleasing head. These uniform, tiny-sized bubbles create the perfect density that delivers the enhanced aroma and flavour, making your favourite tipple taste better than ever.All beers, great and smallWhether you favour IPA’s, Pilsners, stouts, brown ales or lagers, you’ll be able to reap the benefits of the DraftPour experience. And thanks to its versatile design, it can hold both tall and regular size cans and beer bottles up to 650ml.The perfect pint, wherever you arePowered either by a USB cable or 2 x AA batteries, the DraftPour can go wherever the party takes you – the back garden, your mate’s house, on a picnic or even on holiday.

name: Bordeau Masters: Margaux and Pomerol
description: Presented in a contemporary wooden gift box, this refined Bordeaux pairing brings together two distinct expressions of the region’s finest terroirs. From the elegance and maturity of Margaux on the Left Bank to the richness and charm of Pomerol on the Right Bank, this is a beautifully balanced duo that showcases Bordeaux at its most compelling. A thoughtful gift for Bordeaux enthusiasts and a memorable choice for any special occasion. Château Confidence de Margaux 2016 From an outstanding Bordeaux vintage, this mature Margaux displays the finesse and complexity for which the appellation is renowned. Layers of blackcurrant, red cherry and plum are complemented by notes of cedar, tobacco and gentle spice, while finely integrated tannins provide structure and elegance. Sophisticated, harmonious and ready to enjoy. Château Rouget Le Carillon de Rouget Pomerol 2019 The second wine of Château Rouget, this Pomerol is supple, generous and immediately appealing. Ripe plum, black cherry and soft cocoa notes are wrapped in a velvety texture, with gentle spice and earthy undertones adding depth. A rich yet approachable Right Bank expression with real charm and drinkability.

name: Coravin Model Six+ Hermitage Red Limited Edition
description: The Coravin® Timeless™ Six+ wine by-the-glass system pairs premium design with a wide range of accessories, giving you the freedom to pour wine without pulling the cork. With a high-gloss finish, metallic accents and a full set of accessories, including the Coravin Aerator, Screw Caps, and Carry Case – it’s made for wine lovers who will savour the flexibility to explore and enjoy wine by-the-glass on their own terms. The Coravin Timeless uses a precision engineered needle to gently pass through natural cork, allowing wine to be poured while replacing the liquid with 100% pure argon gas, an inert food-safe gas already used in the winemaking process. Once the needle is removed, the cork naturally reseals, keeping the remaining wine completely unaffected, even years later. Designed for use with natural cork, Timeless is also compatible with screwcap bottles when used with the Coravin Screw Cap accessory. The Coravin Aerator offers the equivalent of up to 90 minutes decanting, enhancing the wine's aromas and flavors instantly. What's Included: Timeless Six Wine Preservation System Timeless Aerator Coravin Pure™ Argon Capsules 3-Pack Timeless Standard Screw Caps 6-Pack Timeless Carry Case Needle Clearing Tool Bottle Sleeve
